title: ledger_lock's stale-lock put-back can lose a live lock when a third waiter creates the lock while it is renamed away
goal: a waiter that renamed away a lock it wrongly judged stale never leaves the critical section with two holders or a live holder's lock gone: when the lock name is taken again before the put-back, the live holder's lock still guards the ledger (an owner token in the lock, or the holder unlinking only its own inode), so two of three contenders never both hold the claims ledger lock

run:
import os,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_base as b
d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());L=d/"c.json.lock";L.write_text("");w1=os.stat(L).st_ino
s=d/"old";s.write_text("");seen=os.stat(s)
real=os.link
def link(a,t):
    if not os.path.exists(t):open(t,"w").close()
    return real(a,t)
os.link=link
b._clear_stale_lock(L,seen)
kept=L.exists() and os.stat(L).st_ino==w1
print("live holder lock kept after a third waiter took the name during the put-back:",kept);sys.exit(0 if kept else 1)

gates.question: How does the ledger lock keep a live holder's lock when a third waiter made the lock while it was renamed away?
options: put the renamed-away lock back by an atomic replace and let a holder remove the lock on exit only when it is the file it made
put it back by a hard link and give the lock an owner token the third waiter checks
gates.recommendation: put the renamed-away lock back by an atomic replace and let a holder remove the lock on exit only when it is the file it made
gates.answer: put the renamed-away lock back by an atomic replace and let a holder remove the lock on exit only when it is the file it made

gates.question: How does a stale-lock clear keep a live holder's ledger lock at its name, so no third waiter can enter beside it?
options: never rename the lock away: waiters clear one at a time under an exclusive-create guard file and remove the lock only when it still matches the stat they judged stale
keep the rename-and-put-back and move the lock to an OS file lock in a follow-up item
gates.recommendation: never rename the lock away: waiters clear one at a time under an exclusive-create guard file and remove the lock only when it still matches the stat they judged stale
gates.answer: never rename the lock away: waiters clear one at a time under an exclusive-create guard file and remove the lock only when it still matches the stat they judged stale
